non_blocking.suggestion: OQ-multi-protocol-11 covers only native Kafka wire proxying. The Multi-protocol stance marks NATS client-protocol proxying Not planned without an open question. Write "Kafka wire-protocol ingress Not planned (OQ-multi-protocol-11); NATS client-protocol proxying Not planned" rather than attributing both to OQ-multi-protocol-11.

Topic ingress 'covering KrakenD's EE Kafka async agents' is Planned (M4), but how the async-agent direction is declared is still open (OQ-multi-protocol-10, OQ-configuration-model-11). Name these open questions next to the claim, as the Multi-protocol Topic ingress section does.

OQ-multi-protocol-14 names AMQP, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and Amazon SQS. F-17 adds SNS and Service Bus under the same open question. They fall under the Multi-protocol stance's 'Other brokers (AMQP, cloud queues)' row, but consider asking the multi-protocol owner to list SNS and Service Bus in OQ-multi-protocol-14 explicitly.
